article.headline: Nojus Indrusaitis scores 18 to power California to 96-54 victory over Alabama State
article.description: — Nojus Indrusaitis scored 18 points and California cruised to a 96-54 victory over Alabama State on Monday night.
article.linkText: Nojus Indrusaitis scores 18 to power California to 96-54 victory over Alabama State

categories.description: Alabama State Hornets @ California Golden Bears

event.description: Alabama State Hornets @ California Golden Bears

keywords: Alabama State Hornets @ California Golden Bears
article.story: BERKELEY, Calif. -- — Nojus Indrusaitis scored 18 points and California cruised to a 96-54 victory over Alabama State on Monday night. Indrusaitis made 7 of 13 shots with three 3-pointers for the Golden Bears (5-2), who have won three in a row. He added five assists. Jake Wilkins totaled 13 points and nine rebounds for Cal. Semetri Carr had 12 points and six rebounds and fellow reserves Michael Cooper scored 11. Mantas Kocanas had 10 points on 5-for-5 shooting and five boards. Seventeen Bears saw action and 12 scored. Wilkins had 10 points and eight different Golden Bears scored in taking a 53-25 lead into halftime. Cooper's jumper gave Cal a 16-6 lead six minutes in, and Wilkins' basket pushed the lead above 20 for the first time at 40-19 at the 5:34 mark. Cal shot 69% in the first half, making 20 of 29 shots, including 7 of 12 from 3-point range. Alabama State shot 40.7% and missed 9 of 10 from distance to fall behind. Terrance Hampton and Paul McMillan IV both scored 10 to lead the Hornets (2-5) in the first meeting on the hardwood between the schools — with Hampton adding nine rebounds.. The Bears finished shooting 56% overall, making 8 of 22 from beyond the arc and 18 of 23 at the free-throw line. They scored 24 points off 14 turnovers by the Hornets. Alabama State shot 37% overall and made only 2 of 21 from distance. The Hornets made 8 of 9 foul shots. Up next Alabama State: Hosts Arkansas Monticello on Sunday. California: Plays Minnesota on Saturday at the Sanford Pentagon in Sioux Falls, S.D. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
